answer: A sybil farm's shells are run by the same script, so their behavior clusters: matching cadences, identical timing, answers in the same voice. Make that sameness self-revealing. Hash each identity's on-ledger telemetry — submit cadence, nonce timing, answer embeddings — into a behavior vector, then attenuate rewards where identities cluster: the denser the nebula of look-alikes, the dimmer each shell's payout. Dodging detection means hand-crafting distinct behavior per shell, spending real copper and violet effort on every clone — work that scales with the farm and erases the free ride.
